meta.name: Project Hosting Context
meta.purpose: Explain the current project structure and how to create a new static website in a new repo under the same GitHub account.

deploymentModel.meaning: GitHub Pages is expected to publish from the docs folder inside the main branch, not from a separate branch named main/docs.

basePathBehavior.rule: When GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and GITHUB_REPOSITORY is set, Vite base becomes /<repo-name>/

newStaticProjectGuide.goal: Create a brand new static website with a different repo name under the same GitHub account.
newStaticProjectGuide.importantRule: The new repo name affects the GitHub Pages base path. If the repo is named my-new-site, the site base path should resolve to /my-new-site/ during GitHub Pages builds.
recommendedApproach: Create a new GitHub repository under the same account with the new project name.
Create a new local workspace/folder for that repo.
Initialize a new Vite static project or clone a starter.
Use a docs folder as the published output if you want to keep the same Pages workflow.
Push to the new repository and configure GitHub Pages to deploy from main/docs.

vite.baseRule: const githubRepoName = process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY?.split('/')[1]; const githubPagesBase = process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS && githubRepoName ? `/${githubRepoName}/` : '/';

stepByStep: 1. Create a new repo on GitHub with the new name.
2. Create a new local folder/workspace for that repo.
3. Initialize the app, for example with Vite.
4. Add a docs folder for GitHub Pages output.
5. Configure vite.config.ts so the base path uses the repo name from GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
6. Build the app with GitHub Pages env vars.
7. Copy the built static files into docs.
9. In GitHub Pages settings, set source to main branch and /docs folder.

useThisFileFor: telling another AI where this project lives
describing how to create a new static site repo with the same hosting pattern
aiHandoff.promptStarter: Use project-hosting-context.json as the source of truth for workspace location, build output, GitHub Pages deployment pattern, and new-repo setup rules.
